newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Jospin says totally committed to EMU start on time.
newsitem.headline: Jospin says totally committed to EMU start on time.

text.p: French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin said on Tuesday he was totally committed to launching a single European currency on time but refused to comment on remarks by a junior minister casting doubt on it.

Jospin told a joint news conference with President Jacques Chirac: "On the conditions that I raised during the (election) political debate, I am totally in favour of the single currency, and of launching of the single currency on time."

Jospin was asked about comments by junior European Affairs Minister Pierre Moscovici, who said in a radio interview that France would decide after reviewing its public finances whether or not to join the euro.
The prime minister said there was no need for him to comment on individual ministers' statements, and that Moscovici's remark might have been taken out of context.
But he said his government was profoundly committed to the single currency because it would give Europe greater control over its monetary future and a stronger world role.
